# Security Policy

## Reporting an Issue with the Standard

If you find a weakness in the standard itself — a requirement that can be gamed, a gap in the
threat model, an error in the binary-threshold definition — please
[open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/LFDT-ProofOfControl/ov-poc-standard/issues). The
binary threshold in particular is the standard's most-scrutinized point, and adversarial review
is welcomed; see [Appendix D, issue 6](0.1/en/0x93-Appendix-D_Open-Issues.md).

## Reporting a Sensitive Security Issue

If disclosure of the issue would itself create risk (for example, a practical forgery technique
against a mechanism family the standard relies on), please contact the working group privately
via the [Advanced AI Society](https://advancedaisociety.org/) rather than opening a public
issue.

## Scope

This policy covers the Proof-of-Control specification and this repository. It does not cover
vulnerabilities in third-party implementations of the standard; report those to the respective
implementers.
